side_missions.title: Through the Looking Glass
side_missions.description: The Warp Marches are shifting. Navigation beacons are failing, routes that worked yesterday now lead to dead space. Aristotle needs to chart a new path through the chaos — and whatever's causing the shifts is probably worth finding.

objectives.description: Calibrate navigation systems for Warp March anomalies
Chart a stable route through the shifting lanes

side_missions.title: The Object
side_missions.description: Flux, the shape-shifting trader, has tipped Aristotle off about an alien artifact adrift in the deep space beyond the Warp Marches. It predates every known civilization. It hums with a frequency that makes whisper crystals vibrate in sympathy.

objectives.description: Follow Flux's coordinates to the artifact's location

side_missions.title: Resonance Cascade
side_missions.description: The crystal resonance anomalies from Arc 4 have intensified. The Fairy Collective's top researchers believe they can unlock a new tier of crystal refinement — but the experiments could destabilize entire regions if they go wrong.

objectives.description: Gather crystal samples from three distinct regions
Assist with the resonance cascade experiment
Contain any dangerous fallout from the experiment

side_missions.title: The Web of Whispers
side_missions.description: Every faction is positioning for the endgame. Aristotle needs a clear picture of who's allied with whom, who's about to betray whom, and where the hidden knives are pointed. Time to call in every favour he's ever earned.

objectives.description: Activate Aristotle's intelligence network across all regions
Verify the current state of inter-faction alliances
